name: Next Beverly Hills Committee Liaison Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
Beverly Hills City Council Liaison I Next Beverly Hills Committee
  will conduct a Special Meeting, at the following time and place, and will address the
  agenda listed below:

  CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  Municipal Gallery
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  IN-PERSON I TELEPHONIC I VIDEO CONFERENCE MEETING

  Beverly Hills Liaison Committee Meeting
  https :I/beverlyhills-org.zoom. us/my/nextbh
  Meeting ID: 511 714 8143
  Passcode: 90210

  You can also dial in by phone:
  +1 346 248 7799 US
  +1 833 548 0282 US Toll-free

  One tap mobile
  +13462487799,,5117148143#,,,,*90210# US
  +18335480282,511 7148143#,,,,*9021 0# US Toll-free

  Wednesday, November 13, 2024
  6:30 PM

Please be advised that pre-entry metal detector screening requirements are now in place
in City Hall. Members of the public are requested to plan visits accordingly.

In the interest of maintaining appropriate social distancing, members of the public can view this
meeting through live webcast at www.beverlyhills.orq/live and on BH Channel 10 or Channel
35 on Spectrum Cable, and can participate in the teleconference/video conference by using the
link above. Written comments may be emailed to mayorandcitycouncil(ã!beverlyhills.orcl and
will also be taken during the meeting when the topic is being reviewed by the Beverly Hills City
Council Liaison / Next Beverly Hills Committee. Beverly Hills Liaison meetings will be in-person
at City Hall.

  AGENDA

1)  Public Comment
  a. Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the Committee on any
  item not listed on the agenda.

2)  Welcome & Introductions
  a. Next Beverly Hills Chair Charles Smith and Vice Chair Ellen Labbé
  b. City Council Liaisons Mayor Lester Friedman & Councilmember Mary Wells
  Staff Liaisons Keith Sterling (Deputy City Manager) and Stephanie Harris (Director of
  Community Services)
  c. Introduction of Prospective New Members
 3)  NEXT Beverly Hills Mission Statement
  a. NEXT Beverly Hills (“NBH”) is a committee of talented, next generation leaders focused on
  innovative initiatives which address lifestyle, economic, and civic needs of those in their 20’s,
  30’s and 40’s. Chartered by the Mayor and the City of Beverly Hills, it seeks to engage all who
  are interested to inspire them to make Beverly Hills a better place for all.

4)  New Business
  a. Committee Charter
  i. Existing Charter
  ii. Proposed Amendments
  b. Elections
  i. Current Procedure
  ii. Proposed Amendments
  iii. Updates Vice Chair Election
  -

  c. Committee Attendance, Membership and Subcommittee Appointments
  Current Procedure
  ii. Proposed Amendments
  d. 2025 NEXT Work Plan
  i. Community Engagement
  ii. NEXT Open House Events (Quarterly)
  iii. Engaging Young Professionals
  iv. Engaging Young Families

5) City Council Liaison Update  —  Civic Awareness Updates

6)  City Staff Announcements and upcoming events for the Next Generation
  a. City of Beverly Hills Editorial Calendar

7)  Current Business
  a. Open Discussion
  i. Fall/Winter Event
  1. Holiday Lighting Event (Co-Sponsorship Opportunities)

8)  Post Meeting Networking Session (Off-Site)

9) Adjournment
  a. The upcoming Next Beverly Hills Committee regular meeting is scheduled for Thursday,
  D cember 12th, 2024, at 6:30 p.m.
